apps.name: Trainyard
apps.sentence: Trains an image classifier from your own webcam shots, entirely in the browser.
apps.signature_detail: Per-class confidence lamps that light as the live prediction shifts.
apps.paid_tier_hypothesis: More classes, more examples per class, and saved projects.
apps.notes: From approved idea #2. Audio deferred; the Embedder interface is the seam for it. Score provisional at 7 until tried on a real camera — the e2e fake camera shows one scene for both classes, so real-world accuracy is unverified.
